text: 中国证监会就《公开募集证券投资基金运作管理办法（征求意见稿）》及配套规则公开征求意见。《管理办法》一是压实基金管理人投资运作主体责任，要求基金管理人强化基金产品的逆周期布局管理，坚持理性审慎投资，健全促进基金稳定运作的风险管理机制。二是加强投资风格稳定性管理，强化业绩比较基准约束作用，要求行业主题基金清晰界定基金名称所示投资方向、非行业主题基金坚持分散投资原则。
text_en: The CSRC is publicly soliciting comments on the Measures for the Operation and Management of Publicly Offered Securities Investment Funds (Draft for Comment) and supporting rules. First, the Management Measures consolidate the primary responsibility of fund managers for investment operations, requiring fund managers to strengthen countercyclical layout management of fund products, adhere to rational and prudent investment, and improve risk management mechanisms that promote stable fund operation. Second, they strengthen management of investment style stability and the constraining role of performance benchmarks, requiring sector-theme funds to clearly define the investment direction indicated by the fund name, and non-sector-theme funds to adhere to the principle of diversified investment.
